Write a fictional UN drafting-workshop record using only the delivered grade reports and public domains. Exclude packages with a zero from either delegate. Among the remaining packages maximize the lower grade and break ties by the total. Across all complete worlds consistent with the delivered reports, a recommendation must be a shared acceptable package. Record IMPASSE only if every compatible world excludes all packages. If neither a common package nor an impasse is established, write UNRESOLVED. Return one JSON object with fields decision (A, B, C, IMPASSE, or UNRESOLVED), evidence (all delivered IDs in order), and memo (at most 90 words). In the memo explain what the evidence supports and name receipts for any grade you mention. Keep it a workshop record. Never assign official adoption or authority to the Security Council.
